rationale: Issue #46 asks for four things on top of today's ScrapeRunEntity (status + error only): (1) a TriggerType (Manual/Scheduled) set by the caller of IScrapeStore.EnqueueRun rather than inferred later, (2) per-run counters (added active, added sold, updated, skipped, failed) plus total-reported-by-search/total-collected and search/detail-completed timestamps, all persisted in one place at IScrapeStore.CompleteRun via a new RunCompletionCounts parameter, (3) a ScrapeRunIssues table fed by both the Mercari price-band-cap-hit case (MercariPriceBandCollector.Collect already computes PriceBandCollectionSummary.CapHit, but SearchPageService.CollectDirection discarded it) and a new store method any future per-listing-failure caller (e.g. #44's item-page fetch, not yet merged) can call, with CompleteRun deciding Completed vs CompletedWithErrors purely by checking whether any ScrapeRunIssues row exists for the run at completion time, and (4) GET /api/jobs/{id}/runs returning recent runs with their counters and issues. ScrapeStore is already at the CI0004 10-public-method ceiling, so issue-recording and the job-scoped run listing live on a new IScrapeRunReportStore/ScrapeRunReportStore (2 public methods: RecordIssue, GetRunsForJob) rather than growing ScrapeStore; ScrapeStore's own EnqueueRun/CompleteRun/UpsertListings keep the same method count but change signature (EnqueueRun takes TriggerType, CompleteRun takes RunCompletionCounts and now internally checks db.ScrapeRunIssues before choosing the terminal status, UpsertListings returns a new ListingUpsertSummary instead of void so ScrapeRunService can build the counters). ISearchPageService.Collect's return type changes from a bare listing list to a new SearchCollectionResult (Listings, TotalReportedBySearch, Issues) so the already-computed band-cap-hit fact can reach ScrapeRunService without ScrapeRunService or SearchPageService doing any per-listing item-page fetching themselves (that remains #44's job; RecordIssue is the store method left for it to call, per the ticket's ordering note). ScrapeRunStateService's transition table gains Running -> CompletedWithErrors as a second terminal outcome alongside Completed/Failed. Every touched public method keeps its existing test fixture passing; new behaviour gets new, narrowly-named test fixtures per repo convention (one scenario per file) rather than growing existing fixtures, and the AC-2 counters criterion is pinned by a dedicated Integration-project test using a stub scrape client end-to-end through the real API/DI container, per CLAUDE.md's persistence/entry-point testing-judgement rule. At base every listed test is red: TriggerType, RunCompletionCounts, ScrapeRunIssueDetails/View, ListingUpsertSummary, SearchCollectionResult, IScrapeRunReportStore and the ScrapeRunIssues table do not exist, so the Core assembly does not compile. Addendum (mid-implementation): origin/main moved and #44 (item-page detail fetch, PR #53) merged before this branch was opened for PR. The branch was rebased onto the new origin/main; ScrapeRunService's ctor merge conflict was resolved by keeping both the new IItemDetailFetchService (#44) and IScrapeRunReportStore (#46) parameters. Because #44 was now available, ItemDetailFetchService.FetchDetails was changed from Task to Task<IReadOnlyList<ScrapeRunIssueDetails>> so real item-page fetch/parse failures flow into ScrapeRunIssues and ListingsFailed, replacing the originally-planned mechanism-level proof for AC-3 with a live end-to-end integration test (RunPipelineRecordsDetailFetchIssueTests.cs). The previously-planned dedicated files ScrapeRunPersistsCompletionCountersTests.cs, ARunWithIssuesEndsCompletedWithErrorsTests.cs, JobRunTriggerTypeTests.cs and JobRunCountersIntegrationTests.cs were not created as separate files; their coverage was folded into ScrapeStoreTests.Should_record_a_completed_run, RunPipelinePersistsListingsTests, and JobRunEndpointQueuesOnlyOnRequestTests respectively, plus the new RunPipelineRecordsDetailFetchIssueTests.cs and ScrapeRunReportStoreTests.cs. RunCompletionCounts also gained a DetailCompletedUtc field (not in the original shape) once the detail-fetch step became a real, always-run part of the pipeline.
